issue.title: aliases::completion_offers_group_members_status_flags_and_alias_options intermittently gets no completions on macOS CI

task_type_fields.evidence:
Found by lander bob-cli-an.6.6 while checking master CI on 2026-10-24.

`test (macos-latest)` failed this test on bob-cli master in 2 of the last 7 runs:

- 37594eb2 (run 40031534403)
- 339578cb (run 40078163325)

It passed on macOS at 134016ce, 7e3bdb2e, fb535ef6, 21e674d7, and a08581d8. The commits around the failures do not touch completion: the failure appears at 37594eb2 (web-clip fonts), is gone at 21e674d7 (day timezone), and returns at 339578cb (date-stamp fixes). `test (ubuntu-latest)` passed it in every run, and it passes in local Linux `just check`.

Failure (tests/cli/aliases.rs:515):

```
panicked at tests/cli/aliases.rs:515:9:
missing archive: []
```

So `complete_values(&["bob", "task", ""])` returned no candidates at all, rather than a wrong list. That points to the dynamic completion subprocess returning empty under macOS full-suite load (a timeout or startup race) rather than a group-membership regression. The root cause is unconfirmed: check how `complete_values` invokes the completion engine and whether a timeout or empty-stdout path can return `[]` silently.

issue.creation_reason: An intermittent macOS-only completion-test failure is keeping bob-cli master CI red alongside bob-cli-b5, and no existing bead tracks it.
